recognize_zh: 這是血清免疫固定電泳（IFE，非型態圖）：SP 泳道 gamma 區有一條限制性帶（箭頭），同一位置在 G 與 κ 泳道出現濃密窄帶，λ 泳道只有淡而瀰漫的多株背景，判讀為 IgG κ 單株免疫球蛋白。
features: Serum immunofixation electrophoresis gel with lanes SP (total protein), G, A, M, kappa and lambda; cathode at top, anode at bottom
SP lane shows a restricted band in the gamma region (arrows) above the albumin band
Dense, restricted band in the IgG lane at the same migration position as the arrow
Matching dense band in the kappa lane; lambda lane shows only faint diffuse staining
IgA lane shows a faint narrow band at a different, more anodal position; IgM lane is essentially blank
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic laboratory image: serum protein immunofixation electrophoresis. The total protein (SP) lane shows a restricted band in the gamma region (arrows), which co-migrates with a dense restricted band in the anti-IgG lane and in the anti-kappa lane, while the lambda lane shows only faint diffuse polyclonal staining. A faint narrow band in the IgA lane migrates at a different position and does not correspond to the arrowed paraprotein; its significance cannot be determined from this image alone. The pattern indicates an IgG kappa monoclonal protein, supporting the stated diagnosis of multiple myeloma in conjunction with marrow plasma cell burden and end-organ damage.
